Trump claims Ukraine, Russia agreed to halt attacks on energy infrastructure

US President Donald Trump stated on Monday that Ukraine and Russia have agreed to cease attacks on each other's energy infrastructure. Trump linked this agreement to concerns about rising global diesel prices and fuel supply. He made these claims on Monday.
